title: Missing PartialEq on Session and AccountInfo
description: Session and AccountInfo are public data types returned by fetch_session that lack PartialEq. Both would derive correctly: Session fields are String, HashMap<String, V> (V: PartialEq), and AccountInfo fields are String, bool, HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> (Value: PartialEq). Without PartialEq callers cannot write assert_eq!(session, expected_session) in integration tests, nor use Session in data structures that require equality. serde_json::Value implements PartialEq, so there is no obstacle to deriving. Add #[derive(PartialEq)] (and Eq) to Session and AccountInfo.
